description.value: Riverland Inn & Suites sits directly on the Thompson River with Mount Peter and Mount Paul as a backdrop, roughly a 20-minute walk from downtown Kamloops. The property offers nearly 60 rooms including kitchenette suites, jacuzzi rooms, and a family suite sleeping six. An outdoor BBQ and sun terrace facing the river gives touring cyclists a practical place to clean up and cook.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and corroborates OSM contact details (phone, address, email). The amenities page explicitly confirms laundry (coin-operated machines), free Wi-Fi throughout the property, and complimentary hot breakfast. The dining page confirms numerous restaurants nearby. No mention anywhere of bike storage, bike room, or staff bike procedures, so both required criteria are null. The privacy policy page references stonebridgedawsoncreek.ca, suggesting a shared website template with a sister property — flagged as a concern but not affecting this listing's validity.
concerns: Privacy policy page references https://www.stonebridgedawsoncreek.ca/ as the hotel's site URL, and the front page briefly names 'Stonebridge Dawsons Creek Hote', indicating the privacy policy was copied from a sister property's template. No impact on the Riverland listing itself, but the shared template is notable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating riverside hotel in Kamloops with an active website, confirmed amenities, and bookable rooms — straightforward inclusion.

Laundry.detail: Coin-operated washing machines and dryers available to guests on-site

Nearby evening food.detail: Dining page states cafés, coffee shops, chain restaurants, fast food, and finer dining are 'just minutes away'

wow_evidence: coin-operated laundry...outdoor BBQ and sun terrace facing the river
